about.description: Single-stock perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking Cerebras Systems Inc., cash-settled, 24/7, up to 20x leverage, margined in USDC. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-08-19: mark $209.5600, open interest $345.79K, 24h volume $581.10K. Added 2026-08-19 to reconcile the registry with Ondo's stated 35 RWA markets; the adapter's 40 rows include 5 crypto perps (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, ONDO) that are out of scope.
